product_overview: Advus is a legal practice management platform that centralizes core account access and product discovery. The public site explains value and guides users to register and authenticate to reach their dashboard.
core_goals: Discover the product value and start a new account from the public landing page
Create and manage a user account to access the application dashboard
Recover and reset account credentials to regain access if a password is forgotten
Sign in and reach the authenticated dashboard to begin managing legal work

features.name: Premium Landing Page
features.description: Public-facing marketing and product information page that guides visitors to register or sign in.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll through features and product information -> Choose to register -> Navigate to /register
Navigate to / -> Scroll through features and product information -> Choose to sign in -> Navigate to /login
Navigate to / -> Scroll through features -> Read pricing/feature highlights -> Decide to learn more

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Register new users, authenticate existing users, and provide password recovery and reset flows so users can access the dashboard at /app.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Fill registration form with valid details -> Submit registration form -> See success confirmation and option to sign in
Navigate to /login -> Fill login form with valid credentials -> Submit credentials -> Be redirected to /app and see dashboard
Navigate to /forgot-password -> Fill password recovery form with registered email -> Submit recovery request -> See instruction to check email for reset steps
Navigate to /reset-password -> Fill new password and confirmation -> Submit reset form -> See confirmation that password was updated and option to sign in
Navigate to /register -> Fill registration form with missing required field -> Submit registration form -> See validation error for the missing field
Navigate to /login -> Fill login form with incorrect password -> Submit credentials -> See authentication error indicating incorrect credentials
